description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface to receive log data, format it, and display it within the UI, while supporting chainable log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that formats and displays log messages received via the LogNode interface. It supports chainable logging by forwarding log messages to the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log message details, including log level, tag, message, and optional exception trace, then appends the formatted log to the view and forwards it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
